# Caustics and Lagrangian source provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/compute-toys/wgpu-compute-toy
Pinned revision: `60d0bec4bd912a54d5049f2c28c1bd6a0916e5ec`.

The original Caustics (David A. Roberts, 2022) and 2D Field Lagrangian
Integrator (michael0884) sources and metadata are retained in `originals/`.
Their root MIT notice is `originals/LICENSE`; precise paths and hashes are in
`PROVENANCE.json`. This selection excludes Slime Simulation and makes no
license claim about the rest of compute.toys, FragCoord or Shadertoy.

GODENplayer adapts these works for native HLSL, bounded simulation, musical
forces, artwork pigments and pause/resume. Authors have not endorsed these
adaptations. No shader is downloaded or updated by the running player.
